coder_notes: Two non-randomised experimental cohorts (surgery / non-surgery), both pembrolizumab + abemaciclib; no control. CDKN2A/B/C homozygous deletion and intact RB are listed under general inclusion criteria (applies to all cohorts), coded eligibility and matched to abemaciclib (CDK4/6 inhibitor). The CDKN2C component of the requirement is not separately coded. IDH1/2-mutant excluded, so cns5. RB1 status coded as CDK4_6_pathway (could alternatively be 'other'). TIL density in resected tumour is an immune-cell pharmacodynamic endpoint (pembrolizumab), cited as target-engagement evidence rather than a molecular biomarker row. stdAges includes CHILD but inclusion requires age >=18.
